subject.title: fix(qa-channel): honor canonical thread action fields

question: Should the exported QA-channel adapter formally define canonical `target`, `threadName`, and `message` fields as taking precedence over conflicting legacy aliases?
rationale: The regression repair and alias preservation are well covered, but precedence on conflicting values is an externally observable compatibility rule for a shipped public adapter rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept canonical precedence
options.body: Define the shared action fields as authoritative, retain legacy aliases for compatibility, and merge with the tested canonical-wins behavior.

options.title: Reject conflicting inputs
options.body: Require a narrow follow-up that errors when canonical and legacy values disagree, avoiding silent selection of either representation.

options.title: Preserve legacy precedence
options.body: Keep older direct-adapter behavior authoritative on conflicts, accepting that shared canonical dispatch cannot override it.

recommendation.title: Accept canonical precedence
recommendation.body: Define the shared action fields as authoritative, retain legacy aliases for compatibility, and merge with the tested canonical-wins behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent QA Lab ownership makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the QA bus and exported-adapter contract.
